3: Pity me, O Lord; for I am weak: heal me, O Lord; for my bones are vexed.
4: My soul also is grievously vexed: but you, O Lord, how long?
5: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: save me for your mercy's sake.
6: For in death no man remembers you: and who will give you thanks in Hades?
7: I am wearied with my groaning; I shall wash my bed every night; I shall water my couch with tears.
8: My eye is troubled because of my wrath; I am worn out because of all my enemies.
9: Depart from me, all you that work iniquity; for the Lord has heard the voice of my weeping.
10: The Lord has listened to my petition; the Lord has accepted my prayer.
11: Let all my enemies be put to shame and sore troubled: let them be turned back and grievously put to shame speedily.
